native_probe.source: User-submitted Support probe and two-item variant output

agility.lightness.notes: No Hunter gate: this card is for freely accessible boots; capes are optional alternatives. No Silverhawk alias.

agility.agile_clothing.notes: 85 Agility is unboosted access for earning legs, not a wear requirement; top course starts at 90.

agility.cape.notes: Timed sliding-block/sawblade damage exceptions remain; no claim of absolute damage immunity.

thieving.ardougne_cloak.notes: Combined easy/medium skill minimums; source quests/partial Fairy Tale II remain achievement goals, not a claim that the diary is already complete. Bought grapple avoids optional Fletching/Smithing gates. Cloak 1 lacks this benefit and does not suppress it.

thieving.mushroomy_bag.notes: 80 Crafting is on the creation operation itself, unlike the buyable carved input for the base tool.

thieving.crystal_totem.notes: 85 Agility is recommended by the source, not required. Totems no longer require weekly recharging.

thieving.ring_vitur.notes: 117 is a source-progression gate for the magic stall, not a fabricated equip requirement.

summoning.spirit_cape.notes: 50 Defence is a real purchase requirement. No combat target or ability use recommendation.

summoning.totem.notes: Slayer is a source requirement, not a Slayer tip. No target/tactic advice. 85 Agility is recommended only, not required.

agility.method.penguin.notes: Actual access is partial Cold War; completion conservatively covers the suit stage without guessing a quest var.

agility.method.barbarian.notes: Barcrawl is a mandatory entry goal. No quest config was present in the native quest dump, so no config or completion read is invented.

agility.method.spirit_moths.notes: 85 Hunter is mandatory; full Heralds completion conservatively covers Havenhythe access.

agility.method.anachronia_laps.notes: Top course with continuing codex-page and lap-reward niche; not a low-tier method retained merely because it remains possible.

agility.alt.throne_room.notes: One-time capped XP pool; no claim of endless XP. Stop before Hefin becomes available.

thieving.method.misthalin.notes: Safes themselves do not require the Guild quests; the bag and stethoscope do. No false blanket quest gate.

thieving.method.asgarnia.notes: Safes themselves do not require the Guild quests; the bag and stethoscope do. No false blanket quest gate.

thieving.method.hereditas.notes: Breaking the Seal is a mandatory entry mystery named as an unlock goal; no unverified mystery-completion state is fabricated. Extra Agility shortcuts and higher-level safes are optional. Native heist completion is not separately detected.

thieving.method.asuran.notes: Core Thieving heist, not the old multiplayer Heist minigame. Optional 75/85/97 Agility routes are not imposed as universal entry requirements.

thieving.alt.marketeers.notes: Actual city access is partial Jack of Spades; completion conservatively covers it. Reclassified as a main bracket; original saved ID retained.

thieving.alt.ardougne_knights.notes: Reclassified as a main bracket; original saved ID retained.

thieving.alt.prifddinas.notes: Scaling clan family; not a claim that every clan is available at 91.

prayer.method.altars.notes: 30 is recommendation timing, not a game Prayer requirement. Host Construction levels are not imposed on visitors.

prayer.method.cleansing.notes: Capped at 99; crystals are core training materials, not a temporary bonus applied to a different training method.

prayer.alt.ectofuntus.notes: The Restless Ghost only needs partial progress for the amulet; Ghosts Ahoy and Agility shortcuts are not universal requirements.

prayer.alt.nemi.notes: Capped daily exploration niche, not an unlimited repeatable method or combat recommendation.

excluded_or_deferred.Dungeoneering and Slayer: User explicitly excluded their tip files. No gameplay probe, engine change or delayed Slayer queue is installed. Requirements in those skills remain where they are real item-source requirements.
excluded_or_deferred.Silverhawk boots: Excluded at the user's request because they are being removed. Boot/feather discovery records are evidence only; neither becomes a tip or nimble-outfit alias.
excluded_or_deferred.Temporary boosts: No spirit gems, Summoning foci, incense, burial powders or other repeated consumable boost recommendations. Bones, sand, cleansing crystals and pouch ingredients are core training materials, not boosts applied to another method.
excluded_or_deferred.Minigame training: No Skullball, Brimhaven arena, Pyramid Plunder or other minigame training cards. A durable outfit can still name a reward source. Current high-level Thieving heists are distinct from the older multiplayer Heist minigame.
excluded_or_deferred.Guaranteed quest rewards: Trahaearn exoskeleton and Dragon Rider amulet are candidates for the following useful quest-unlock pass. Avoid standalone post-quest item tips that are immediately suppressed by the guaranteed reward they require.
excluded_or_deferred.Combat advice: No targets to fight, combat abilities, protection-prayer choices or Slayer logistics tips. Familiar/Prayer equipment descriptions do not recommend combat tactics.
excluded_or_deferred.Unknown account state: Do not invent reads for tool belt, house/Diango storage, active relics/totems or partial quest/mystery stages. Known ownership persists once observed. Unobserved pre-install storage and learned unlocks remain limitations.

early_thieving_correction.notes: Main pickpocketing brackets begin at 10. Existing marketeer/knight IDs retained as main brackets 46-49 and 55-61. Only men/women at level 1 omitted. Cave goblins require Death to the Dorgeshuun; choose accessible Campus trainee and quest-free brigands. H.A.M. men and women both currently require 15. Level 53 bandits are the desert camp variant, not Pollnivneach (55).
